name: Surabaya Open 2022

venue.name: [Glück Kaffee & Bäckerei](https://g.co/kgs/mepGnn)
venue.address: Jl. Pakis Tirtosari No.885, RT.002/RW.10, Pakis, Kec. Sawahan, Kota SBY, Jawa Timur 60256

information: Surabaya Open 2022 will be the first speedcubing competition in 4 years after its absence. The purpose of this competition is to re-establish and re-connect the cubing community, as well as to re-ignite the spirit of Speedcubing competition in Surabaya and East Java, particularly. All competitors must read the COVID-19 Prevention Tab before registering, and all guests must read it before attending.
